about: GTA 6 Trailer 2 (Rockstar Games, May 6, 2025) opens on Jason Duval up on a roof; a man below asks "What you doing up there?" and Jason says "I'm just fixing some leaks." (heard in the trailer). Context: on September 19, 2022 Rockstar confirmed a network intrusion that leaked early development footage of the next Grand Theft Auto (about 90 videos, per reporting); on December 4, 2023 Rockstar posted "Our trailer has leaked" hours before Trailer 1's premiere. Rockstar never said the line is about the leaks: labeled THEORY. Trailer mode: three muted Trailer 2 excerpts under 3 s each, annotated. Delta.

lines.text: GTA 6 Trailer 2 opens with a joke.
lines.say: G T A six Trailer 2 opens with a joke.

lines.text: Jason is up on a roof.
A man below asks what he's doing up there.
His answer? I'm just fixing some leaks.
Why is that funny? In 2022, a hacker leaked 90 videos of early GTA 6.
lines.say: Why is that funny? In twenty twenty-two, a hacker leaked ninety videos of early G T A 6.

lines.text: Rockstar confirmed it was their early footage.
Then in 2023, Trailer 1 leaked before its premiere.
lines.say: Then in twenty twenty-three, Trailer 1 leaked before its premiere.

lines.text: Rockstar never said the roof line is a joke.
So, joke or coincidence? One word.
